title: Invariant-Theory Rank Lemma
body_html:
Invariant-Theory Rank Lemma

For split irreducible dual pairs with \(\operatorname{rank}G\le\operatorname{rank}G'\), there is a \(Y\times Y'\)-stable linear subspace \(A\subset W\) making the invariant quotient diagram commute: \[ \mathbf y/W_G \to \mathbf y'/W_{G'}. \] The induced map on Cartan invariant quotients is the natural coordinate inclusion.
proof_html: Appendix 2 constructs \(A\) by explicit matrices in the general linear, symplectic-orthogonal, and related classical cases. Restricting the two moment maps to \(A\) gives diagonal coordinate formulas. Inspecting the discriminant polynomials on the two Cartan quotients yields the finite rank list used by the rank-restriction theorem.
